entries.candidate: Nxtra Mahape Plot IT 07 - proposed Data Center Building 2 (Ground + 8; expansion EC EC24C3802MH5926451N of 21 November 2025)
entries.reason: The SEIAA Maharashtra EC of 21 November 2025 (local nxtra/nxtra-mahape-dc02-ec-2025-11-25.pdf) clears the merged Phase 2/3 Data Center Building 2 and DG building on the same plot, and Esri imagery shows a cleared plot with piling rigs south of the existing building, but the EC is 339 days old, imagery is undated, Nxtra's SR FY2025-26 mentions a 'Mahape DC' built with pre-engineered steel without a date or plot, and no dated in-window statement of works was found. The Plot IT 07 campus itself is not in the Atlas: its existing-operations addition was held by the verifier (see the next entry), so Building 2 would also need a new site.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated Nxtra statement or a six-monthly EC compliance report (April-September 2026, due by 1 December 2026) recording works on Data Center Building 2. If the Plot IT 07 campus has been admitted by then, add Building 2 as a new project on curated:nxtra-mahape-plot-it07-data-centre-campus reusing the campus locator exactly; otherwise only one of the two projects can be added in the update that creates the site.

entries.candidate: Nxtra Mahape data-centre campus, Plot IT 07, TTC Industrial Area, Navi Mumbai - existing operations of Phase 1 Data Center Building 1 (proposed key curated:nxtra-mahape-plot-it07-data-centre-campus:existing-operations; removed by verifier worker 2, iteration 26)
entries.reason: The in-window status source, Nxtra's Mumbai page (version 2026-09-15, bounded by Internet Archive copies of 15 May and 1 October 2026), says the Mumbai cluster has '4 facilities including two hyperscale sites in Mahape' and lists Mahape 1 (MUM 3, 18 MW IT) and Mahape 2 (MUM 4, 42 MW IT), but gives no address, plot or map for either, so it does not identify Plot IT 07. It is also not a reliable observation that a given Mahape facility is operating: the same cluster sentence and the same Mahape 1 / Mahape 2 listing with identical MW and rack figures already appear in the page versions of 11 August 2025 and 24 December 2025 (Internet Archive copies of 12 September 2025 and 16 January 2026, fetched by the verifier), when the Plot IT 07 Phase 1 building was recorded as in internal fit-out (compliance report, March 2025) and the second building was only an EC application (7 August 2025). Nxtra's own file name for the expansion EC is 'Nxtra Mahape_DC-02', and the listed capacities scale with the two IT 07 buildings' built-up areas (18 MW for 21,688.79 m2; 42 MW for the proposed 55,241.23 m2), so 'Mahape 2' may well be the unbuilt Data Center Building 2, i.e. the page lists planned capacity alongside operating capacity. Construction completion of Phase 1 is established only by the EC of 21 November 2025 and the October 2024-March 2025 compliance report, both outside the 85-day window. Nxtra's published coordinates for the plot are also inconsistent: the EC point (19.100125, 73.0202722; page 5 row 10, confirmed on a 250 dpi crop) and the 2024-25 compliance report point agree within 25 m and sit at the south side of a large building with rooftop plant on Esri imagery, but the July-December 2023 compliance report for the same plot prints 19°10'34.17"N, 73°0'5.09"E, 8.65 km away. The EC point is a usable campus locator; the status observation is what fails.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated primary record on or after the 85-day window start that ties Plot IT 07 (or 'Mahape 1'/'Mahape 2' mapped to Plot IT 07 by Nxtra) to an operating or completed status: for example Nxtra's April-September 2026 six-monthly EC compliance report for Plot IT 07 (due by 1 December 2026) reporting Phase 1 complete or in operation, an occupancy certificate or full fire NOC, or a dated Nxtra/Airtel statement naming the Mahape Plot IT 07 data centre as live. Then admit with the EC point (local nxtra/nxtra-mahape-dc02-ec-2025-11-25.pdf, page 5 row 10) as an official campus locator, citing the 2023 report's divergent coordinate in the identity review.
